# IBM Quantum Platform

> > Cloud-based quantum computing platform providing access to quantum processing units (QPUs), circuit development tools, and the Qiskit framework for quantum programming and experimentation.

IBM Quantum Platform enables researchers, developers, and enterprises to build, test, and run quantum circuits on real quantum hardware. The platform features visual development tools like Composer, supports QASM programming, and provides advanced capabilities for error mitigation and quantum algorithm development.

## Key Topics

- IBM Quantum Platform
- Qiskit
- Quantum Processing Units (QPUs)
- Quantum Circuits
- Composer (Circuit Builder)
- QASM (Quantum Assembly Language)
- Error Mitigation
- Pauli Noise
- Adaptive Circuits
- Probabilistic Error Amplification
- Quantum Programming
- Quantum Hardware Access
- Quantum Information Science
- Visual Circuit Editor

## Platform & Tools

- [IBM Quantum Platform](https://quantum.cloud.ibm.com/): IBM Quantum Platform homepage - cloud access to quantum computing with QPUs
- [Composer | IBM Quantum Platform](https://quantum.cloud.ibm.com/composer): Quantum circuit builder with visual editor and QASM support
